purpose: Machine-readable distribution queue for the Acquisition Intelligence Engine. Every item was produced by acquisition/cli/route.mjs from a scored demand signal and a verified inventory asset. Nothing here is published automatically: SCHEDULED and beyond require approval_status HUMAN_APPROVED.

state_contract.READY: safety passed; waiting for a human approval decision
state_contract.SCHEDULED: approved and handed to a publisher with a scheduled_at
state_contract.PUBLISHED: an external_post_id exists; the request alone is never enough
state_contract.VERIFIED: an independent status read confirmed the post is live
state_contract.ERROR: blocked or failed; carries the reason

items.content_angle: AI tools are being expensed across a team without a shared record, and someone now has to justify the total before the next renewal. Run the reducible-spend estimate.
items.notes: Instagram already carries an in-flight ai_saas_cost_review run for this same destination (distribution/launch-now.json). The cross-lane collision guard is expected to block this item until that run is confirmed published or failed.

items.content_angle: An AI agent looks cheap per call but the human review it triggers may erase the saving, and nobody has done that arithmetic. Estimate agent payback.
items.notes: No creative asset has been produced for this item yet. Creative production and the human approval decision both remain HUMAN_REQUIRED.
